title: A public API wrapper tool
request:
Wrap the public API at https://api.open-notify.org/iss-now.json as an MCP tool
named get_iss_position that takes no arguments and answers {"latitude": number,
"longitude": number, "timestamp": number}. The API answers
{"message":"success","timestamp":1700000000,"iss_position":{"latitude":"12.5","longitude":"-45.1"}}
with the coordinates as strings. Put the parsing in lib/iss.ts as an exported
function parseIssResponse(body: unknown) that returns the tool's answer and
throws an Error when the body is not a "success" response, and write tests for it.
